findings.title: Payment capture failure is swallowed and the order is marked paid
findings.description: The catch block only logs, so when gateway.capture rejects (declined card, timeout) execution continues to setStatus('paid') and the order is fulfilled unpaid. Re-throw (or mark the order payment_failed and return) instead of continuing.
findings.suggestion: Remove the swallow: let the error propagate or set status to payment_failed and return before marking paid.
